title: feat(billing): add precision decimal tax helper with unit tests
author_note: 使用 Python 标准库 decimal 计算税额，环境变量读取配置并补齐正反向严格断言单测。
diff:
--- a/services/tax.py
+++ b/services/tax.py
@@ -1,4 +1,14 @@
+import os
+from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
+
+TAX_CONFIG_SOURCE = os.environ.get("TAX_RATE_ENV_VAR", "DEFAULT_STD")
+
+def calc_tax_cents(amount_cents: int, rate: Decimal) -> int:
+    if amount_cents < 0 or rate < Decimal("0"):
+        raise ValueError("amount_cents and rate must be non-negative")
+    raw = (Decimal(amount_cents) * rate).quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
+    return int(raw)
--- a/tests/test_tax.py
+++ b/tests/test_tax.py
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+import pytest
+from decimal import Decimal
+from services.tax import calc_tax_cents
+
+def test_calc_tax_cents_rounding_and_negative_guard():
+    assert calc_tax_cents(1999, Decimal("0.075")) == 150
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        calc_tax_cents(-100, Decimal("0.075"))
